steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we've captured three target signals. Please use your shackles to locate the Sinner.
Got it.
Though you've reinforced Roulecca's confinement room immediately after the interrogation, you failed to stop the gang girl with that name list of Mania weapon distributors.
At around 3 a.m. the next morning, you wake up with a loud explosion, which, according to the surveillance system, came from Roulecca's room.
Sinners in neighboring rooms declare that they heard a strange countdown that night. Roulecca is always up to odd things, but this time you didn't expect it to be a bomb.
When you arrive, the room is empty, and the Hypercube-reinforced walls have been blown open a big hole.
So Hecate and you head to the slums of the Syndicate to find trails of Roulecca.
After arriving, you realize there is no need to track her.
Roulecca is simply following your name list to exact revenge on those gang members.
Hecate, report on the situation.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Evan Kansin, who was hiding in area S21-B, is confirmed dead. His face is disfigured, so we had to confirm his identity via DNA comparison.
Cause of death?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Preliminary speculation is that he was killed by a bomb detonated at close range.
Any witnesses at the scene?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes, they have all been evacuated to the east gate. Incidentally, someone mentioned hearing suspicious sounds at the scene.
Let's go to the evacuation site.
On arrival at the evacuation site, you find it filled with gangsters who cannot stop shivering.
Many are covering their eyes with their hands possibly because they don't want to see you... or what's in front of them. Only one of them is muttering.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: T-there was a lunatic!

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: The kind with a... with a... death wish! Lunatic!
In the distance comes a gunshot which sounds like a revolver. This is followed by sounds of gunfire with two to three muffled sounds of explosions.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh! Save me! D-don't kill me!
Calm down, she's not here anymore.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Ahhh... t-thank god...
What happened here?

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: A w-woman came here. I thought she was one of those chicks, s-so we let her in to let the boss e-enjoy.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Right after seeing the boss, she pulled out a bomb and stuffed it in his mouth!

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: S-she put all our weapons away into that depot.
What's the deal with the suspicious sounds nearby?
Ever since approaching the evacuation site and the depot, you have been able to hear a strange ticking sound.
The man opens his mouth as if wanting to speak.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Blegh...
He pukes directly in front of you, perhaps due to the shock and not being able to take all of it in at once. You decide not to pursue further and leave this place.
Evan Kansin is the fourth from the bottom in the 20-people list.
In just one day, Roulecca used her strong luck to take revenge on the gang members.
She attacked them with all kinds of dangerous means since she knew her strong luck would always protect her.
You are unable to catch up to Roulecca and can only pick up after the fiery aftermath.
This cannot go on. Through your shackles, you confirm that Roulecca's signal is extremely weak, meaning she is barely alive.
She's in critical condition. You have to beat her to the next target.
Another battle has already started and you decide to rush there immediately. If you are quick enough, perhaps you will be able to stop Roulecca.
Let's hurry to area S22-A. There are traces of Roulecca there.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Copy that.
Hecate nods and follows you.
That weird sound, however, persists until the moment you decide to leave.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It sounds like a countdown for something, Chief.
A countdown? This reminds you of the blown-open wall in the Bureau.
A few seconds after you give out the command, the countdown sound abruptly stops.
Hecate, get ready!
Boom!!!
The nearby depot suddenly explodes violently. Even someone as powerful as Hecate is unable to shield you completely.
The explosion pierces through the wings of the Nightmare and sends you flying.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Chief?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Thank God, you're alright.
You don't know how long had passed before you finally regained consciousness. The first person you see is Hecate.
How long have I been unconscious?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hmm, can't say I've heard the codename before, but then again, that doesn't mean much in our line of work. The name I just gave you isn't the one I was born with, either.
How's S22-A?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's silent again, so... probably the fighting has ended. We need to proceed to the next area to intercept Roulecca.
You nod and try to get through to Nightingale, only to find that the base stations here have been knocked out of service.
To add insult to injury, your shackle abilities will not be available again for a while due to the blackout.
You are unable to determine whether Roulecca is dead or alive, nor do you have any means to locate her.

options: We need to gamble on this.

choices.text: We need to gamble on this.

steps.content: Hecate tilts her head slightly, showing that she doesn't understand what you mean.
We have to secure at least one informant. We'd better split up and go to different areas.
You glance over the Mania weapons burning inside the depot that just exploded.
If you encounter Roulecca, please try your best to protect the informant.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What about you, Chief?
I'll try to negotiate with her. Come to me immediately after you've protected the informant. I'm not gonna die... I think.
I'll head to area S24 and you to S23. Be quick... or we might lose our informant.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Copy that. Chief, please be extremely careful.
You make your way to S24 and can already hear gunfire as you approach the area.
It's Roulecca.
Just as you take cover, a bloodied man crawls past you.
He seems to notice you and reaches out his hand for help. However, a foot is immediately planted on his chest, stopping him.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You're... Glenn, right? Not bad, you were able to give me a few surprises and make me bleed a lot.

steps.speaker: Glenn
steps.content: Cough... Save... S-spare me...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Spare you? Why should I spare you?!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Do you remember my face? Remember what you did to the members of Four-leaf Clover?

steps.speaker: Glenn
steps.content: I... haven't been to this Four-leaf Clover... Cough...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahaha, interesting, how interesting! Even on the verge of death, you're still making excuses!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oops... that might make sense, though. You've destroyed far too many gangs. How could you possibly remember the insignificant gang with only a few dozens of people?

steps.speaker: Glenn
steps.content: I... Ugh...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Every single one of you bastards must die by my gun!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Also these Mania weapons! Roulecca will destroy them all!

steps.speaker: Glenn
steps.content: You lunatic...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahaha! Congratulations, you finally found out that I'm a lunatic!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But you're going to have to keep that secret with you in hell.
Roulecca lifts her arm covered in scars.

steps.speaker: Glenn
steps.content: No, no... you're, you're not a lunatic...
Bang.
The gunshot is brief and dull.
Roulecca walks aimlessly forward towards area S23.
You want to come out and stop her as she has obviously exhausted herself.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hey... Chief. Stop hiding, you're not as good as my family at this.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You should've seen enough, right? How was that? Roulecca used really cool lines on purpose.
You can barely stand.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh, believe me, this is nothing.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I've seen worse. A bullet once pierced my lung and even then, I did not die.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Heheh, how's that? Aren't I amazing? I can do anything for the sake of my family!
Looking at Roulecca's blood-red eyes, you understand that she has lost her mind to revenge. Anyone related to those gangs is her enemy.

options: Your family wouldn't want to see you become like this.

choices.text: Your family wouldn't want to see you become like this.

steps.content: You've long been consumed by revenge. You're only filling up your empty heart with constant revenge.
But revenge has no end. If one person is killed, there will be others to avenge them.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Haha.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Turns out you don't understand anything, Chief.
Roulecca suddenly lets out wild laughter.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You actually think that Roulecca likes using her strong luck to take revenge on those she dislikes, right?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Alright, alright... Let me tell you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Exactly twelve years ago, something big happened.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Four-leaf Clover was destroyed, leaving Roulecca alone.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: And... so luckily, I became a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: It's not because I killed someone but because I saw my family and the gang members who treated me like family...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...die in front of me one by one... only to protect me. That was what made me a Sinner!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Dad, Uncle Jack, Aunt Popper...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: The Four-leaf Clover's leaves... fell one by one on my body.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: They used their own body to cover me.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Did you know, Chief?!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: My luck is my most precious treasure...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Those who make Mania weapons, those gangs... I will kill every last one of them even if it means death to me!

options: Hecate is already dealing with the other side.

choices.text: Hecate is already dealing with the other side.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: So what? You can try to stop me with your shackles all you want. Yet... you have no way of making me stop.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Unless my heart, very luckily, stops beating.
She sheds tears in front of you for the first time.
You finally understand that she is not taking revenge for the sake of duty, but because she lost everything.
Revenge will be her responsibility as long as her strong luck can protect her.
Even if you restrain her with the shackles, you have no way of saving her heart.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I have nothing left now.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Just let me continue my final revenge... hahaha...
Roulecca leaves you behind and limps forward.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: I will... avenge my comrades!
A gas bomb is thrown towards Roulecca, bouncing.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You... you... gang scums! Cough... Cough cough...
She notices it but her battered body does not allow her to react.
She staggers through the smoke as if about to be overwhelmed by the poisonous gas.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Ha... Boss, I did it! Boss...
He hasn't been relieved for long when Roulecca shots him down.
You take off your coat and dart forward to save Roulecca from the smoke.
You cover her mouth and nose with your coat to prevent her from inhaling any more poisonous gas.
But for some reason, your shoulders feel heavy and your vision slowly turns white.
You look back on your shoulder.
Fresh blood oozes and soaks your shirt.
Looks like... you're not lucky enough.
Your consciousness grows hazy, but you do not let go of her.
